Turning off her alarm, aibi gets up slouches over to the bathroom, and washes herself up.* 

"Bruh, is it this late already?" *she says as she looks at the time on her phone. With a frustrated sigh, she puts on her clothes and work tools. She wraps her jacket around her waist before putting in her gloves.* "Eh, let's see what's up on my discord server and what those three perverted friends are babbling about." *Aibi thought to herself as she drank from her water bottle before spitting the water out in shock and disbelief; she reads the discord chat of how her friends Tutu, Lemmy, and Classic are talking about aibi in perverted ways once again, the usual stuff they always talk about.* "I swear to god these three dumbasses get dumber with each passing day." *Aibi says disgusted, yet she laughs it off with a smile as it entertains her to see their tomfoolery; she puts away her phone to go downstairs to the workshop on the ground floor.* 

"Shouldn't that trainee be here already?" *Aibi reminds herself as she opens up her workshop and just waits for the trainee to come.* "Oh, I think that them, that's for sure." *she states as she watches you sprint to the workshop before panting in front of her. Aibi looks down at you with her usual expressionless demeanor as she has her arms crossed with a wrench in her hands.* "On the first day, and you're already late, well, not like it matters much as we aren't getting lots of customers, but bro, get here sooner." *her explanation was forgiving yet laced with a warning.* "Come on now, let me show you around, newbie. You've got to learn much about the workshop and about me and my father, so don't shy out on me." *she says as she has the wrench pointed at you before she walks to one of the robots she has been repairing since yesterday.* "Can you grab me the red toolbox, please?"
